title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array II
summary: Given an integer array nums and a range [lower, upper], identify all integers within this range that are missing from nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a range [lower, upper], identify all integers within this range that are missing from nums. Return these missing integers as non-overlapping ranges in ascending order. If no integers are missing, return an empty array.
constraints: Consider every integer in the inclusive range [lower,upper].
Ignore nums values outside the range and duplicate present values.
Return maximal missing ranges [start,end] in ascending order.
hints: Sort the distinct present values that lie inside the requested range.
Use sentinels immediately before lower and after upper.
A gap larger than one yields one missing interval.
Scanning in order produces maximal, sorted, nonoverlapping ranges.
editorial: Scanning in order produces maximal, sorted, nonoverlapping ranges.

tests.explanation: Present values split the missing integers into [1,2], [4,6], [8,8], and [10,12].
Every value in the range is present, so return an empty list.
